blocks.text: A modern take on an archival 1970s Coach design, our structured Tabby shoulder bag is crafted of quilted plush, ultra-soft nappa leather and is finished with our Signature hardware for an iconic touch. Inside zip and magnetic snap pockets, pushlock closure, fabric lining, outside slip pocket, chain strap with 21 1/2' drop for shoulder or crossbody wear, 10 1/4' (L) x 5 1/2' (H) x 3 1/4' (W)

items.label: Editor's Notes
items.value: A modern take on an archival 1970s Coach design, our structured Tabby shoulder bag is crafted of natural grain leather and finished with our Signature brass hardware for an iconic touch

items.label: Natural Grain Leather
items.value: A Natural Choice. Our semi-vegetable tanned natural grain leather has a classic softly textured feel and unique character - for a perfectly classic Coach bag

items.label: Style Three Ways
items.value: The compact Tabby 26 features two detachable straps to carry by hand, style as a short shoulder bag or wear crossbody

items.label: It's All in the Details
items.value: Inside snap, multifunction pockets, snap closure, leather lining, outside zip pocket, detachable straps: 9 1/2" drop and 21 1/2" drop for shoulder or crossbody wear. 10" (L) x 5 1/2" (H) x 2 3/4" (W)

items.label: This is COACH
